description: Five-feature excerpt of a successful bounded real OpenStreetMap Overpass response; NOT the complete raw HTTP response.
transform: Five fully observed ways copied from the successful tool response; bounds and node ids removed; tags reduced to rendering-relevant subset. All retained coordinates and tag values were observed in that response. Not synthesized geography. Initial full response was not persisted, and subsequent probe output overwrote successful saved file.
transportNotes: GET returned HTTP 200 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin:* on multiple probes. POST probes returned HTTP500 without CORS headers; later GET probes also intermittently returned500. Do not infer reliable availability or POST browser success from this fixture.
